snippet: Product Concept authorized. Target: Low cost, phone-powered, no disposable batteries.
Solteras defines scope: Mic housing with N.C. switch (ITT/Dong Hyun).
ID Spec: Wire/Cord defined as Pantone 431C. Matte Chrome finish specified.
Consultant Agreement executed: Mechanistic engaged for complex surfacing.
Crisis: Ultrasonic welding deemed impossible due to spacing. Assembly method questioned.
Section A-A drawing generated to analyze housing volume.
BOM Rev 1.0 issued for diagnostic 'square version' prototype.
Top PCB layout sketches: Component keepouts defined for JLS1300-0101.
Change Order: Pantone 431C swapped to Black.
Shinwoo Audio establishes M-12 Plug measurement protocol.
Quality Alert: Plug dimension C guaranteed via A-part jig setup.
BOM Rev 8.0: Micronas DSP lead time hits 23 weeks ($7.95 unit cost).
BOM Rev 8.0: National Semi USB controller lead time hits 16 weeks.
Design Directive: Review Samsung MP3 Headset for jack integration.
Tooling Violation: Rib 5 snap cannot be molded together. 'Add Bridge'.
Button design proposal: Move switches to actuate.
Snap fit dimensions defined: 0.4mm engagement.
Shinwoo Audio requests clearance definition between switch housing and PCB2.
Critical Risk: Housing transformation expected during temperature shock testing.
Directive: Maximize wall thickness to mitigate thermal warping.
Logo Lens Y axis shift identified.
Tooling Query: Do we need rib at end to limit travel in Y?
Assembly Mismatch 01 identified. Strain relief failing during pull test.
Injection Failure: Cover thickness must increase by 0.4mm to mold successfully.
